The Routing Analyst is responsible for building and maintaining accurate and efficient route schemes in routing systems for [Company name masked] locations and our school district customer. The Routing Analyst interacts with customer and location contacts on a daily basis to ensure route updates and changes are performed on a timely basis. This position will also provide routing and data support for consulting and analytical studies conducted by [Company name masked].
cond_0102.responsibilities:
Initialize, configure and populate all data components required in computerized routing systems, including: maps, boundaries, hazards, school parameters, transportation policies and students – training is provided for routing platforms used.
Loads and edits map, student and transportation data within computerized routing systems.
Works with source data in various formats, including: Excel, Access, Word, and text files.
Recognizes and resolves issues associated with data loading, data quality, etc.
Coordinate routing updates and change requests across multiple locations.
Acts as day-to-day point contact for [Company name masked] location staff and school district administrators.
Keep supervisor apprised of any issues, challenges, special requests in locations.
Assist other [Company name masked] staff with complex analyses in various software packages of student, transportation, boundary, or other data.
Logs hours worked and other relevant project information into web-based tracking tool.
Performs other duties and responsibilities as assigned including help with special projects.
Complies with [Company name masked]'s Code of Business Conduct and Ethics.
cond_0102.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Some problem-solving ability and willingness to develop written and verbal communication skills.
Experience working independently and in a team-oriented, collaborative environment, or openness to building that working style.
Working knowledge of MS Office suite.
Reasonable keyboarding skills.
Ability to analyze and troubleshoot various data formats; comfort with learning to do this quickly and accurately over time.
Willingness to learn to work with electronic maps.
Willingness to learn to navigate complex systems.
Training will be provided.
